messages:
maria: Heads-up — I have to run to the airport early. I’m scheduled primary from 18:00-02:00 UTC but my flight is boarding now. Can someone pick up primary immediately? Theres an ongoing latency surge in eu-west and the pager is active. @josh @liam @sasha please advise.

incident-bot: Pager triggered: latency_surge_eu (SEV-2) — incident 1779998875 — affected: hosted-api (route: /v1/generate, embeddings pipeline). Pager owner: maria. Current alerts: 12m ago. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/1779998875

josh: I can take primary now. Are there any in-flight runbooks I should follow beyond the usual latency surge playbook?

sasha: I can shadow for the first 30m and handle customer-facing comms if needed.

liam: Ill be available as secondary unless something else pops.

maria: Thanks all. Quick handoff checklist (do these in order):

```
1) confirm oncall transfer: `oncall-swap --from maria --to josh`
2) claim PagerDuty: `pd takeover --incident 1779998875 --assignee josh`
3) verify routing + capacity: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference | grep eu-west`
4) check KV-cache hit rate + prefix cache: dashboard -> /dashboards/kv-cache-eu
5) tail runtime logs for p95 spikes: `kubectl logs -n inference inference-runtime-gpu-1 --tail=200 | grep -i latency`
6) post short note to #customer-impact if error rate > 2% or any 5xxs
```

Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-surge (follow section "eu region — rapid handoff")

maria: executing step 1 -> running `oncall-swap --from maria --to josh` now. Will also run `pd takeover` and then step back.

oncall-rotations-bot: oncall-swap acknowledged. New primary: josh (effective 1779998895). Secondary: liam. Shadow: sasha.

josh: Im primary now. Quick sanity checks:
- kubectl shows eu-west pods healthy (5/5 Ready)
- KV-cache hit rate: 78% (dashboard last 5m)
- tail logs show p95 generation latency ~ 1.2s, p50 ~ 240ms. Not great but consistent.

sasha: Im posting a short customer note draft to #customer-impact: "Were investigating elevated latencies in EU. No data loss, degraded response times for some requests. Primary handling — team is on it." Will ping when posted. :memo:

liam: thanks. josh, whats the escalation timeline here? If p95 > 2s for >10m do we escalate to infra oncall?

josh: yes — follow the runbook: if p95 > 2s for 15m or error rate > 3% escalate to eng-sre and open a Sev-1 bridge. Ill watch dashboards and trigger if thresholds hit.

maria: thanks everyone — Im handing over remote now. Safe to board. :airplane:

josh: confirmed takeover done. Ive muted marias pager on PagerDuty and set my notification to mobile. Starting 10m intensive watch, will update every 10m or on any threshold breach.

incident-bot: Update: recent alert bursts subsided slightly. New alert count: 4 in last 5m. No new incidents created.

sasha: posted customer note to #customer-impact and linked incident: https://slack.redwood/internal/customer-impact/1234. Copy below: "Investigating higher latencies in EU. Team is on active mitigation. We will follow up with ETA."

liam: will hold secondary pager. If anyone needs to swap later, say now — I can extend.

josh: quick action I took: rolled a small config bump to split traffic across eu-west nodes (`kubectl apply -f /ops/traffic-split-eu.yaml`) — observing for 3m.

josh: initial effect: p95 down to ~920ms over last 2m. continuing to monitor.

maria: perfect handoff, thanks all. Im offline for boarding. josh please call if you need anything urgent — otherwise Ill check in after landing. :thumbsup:
